functions.name: vault_directory
functions.title: Read Vault Account Directory
functions.description: Read the signed-in admin's saved account references, never credentials or access keys. Supports pages of 50 records; pass the returned next_offset to read another page. Connection type indicates a slot or reference, not verified live status.

offset.description: Starting offset from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0.

functions.name: submit_lead
functions.title: Submit Lead
functions.description: Submit a new lead or newsletter signup to Strategic Minds AI. Use when someone wants to contact the agency or join the newsletter. Creates a CRM contact for contact-form submissions and schedules a follow-up. Returns ok on success.

form_type.description: newsletter for newsletter signups, contact for contact form submissions

message.description: Message body. Required for contact form (min 6 chars), optional for newsletter. Max 5000 chars.

functions.name: request_quote
functions.title: Request Quote
functions.description: Request a custom quote for a catalog item priced as 'quote'. Use when a prospect wants a tailored proposal for an enterprise or custom service. Returns ok on success.

itemId.description: The catalog item ID to request a quote for

functions.name: discover_capabilities
functions.title: Discover Connected Capabilities
functions.description: Run a read-only discovery probe across all connected integrations (Google, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, Railway, Stripe, AI Gateway). Admin only. Returns which services are connected and verified for read access. Use when checking the health of the agency's integrations.

functions.name: admin_assistant_chat
functions.title: Admin Assistant Chat
functions.description: Send a message to the Strategic Minds AI admin assistant powered by the Vercel AI Gateway. Returns a text reply for planning, writing, and answering questions. Admin only. Pass an array of messages with role 'user' or 'assistant' and string content.

messages.description: Conversation messages, most recent last. Max 12 messages, each up to 4000 chars.

executionMode.description: plan = analyze and draft plans only; build = produce reviewable implementation drafts

functions.name: admin_account_overview
functions.title: List Connected Infrastructure Accounts
functions.description: List connected infrastructure accounts for a given provider (vercel, supabase, github, or railway). Admin only. Returns project/repo lists with IDs, names, and management URLs.

provider.description: Which infrastructure provider to list accounts for

functions.name: admin_chat_history
functions.title: Manage Admin Chat History
functions.description: List, begin, complete, or clear admin chat conversation history. Admin only. Use action 'conversations' to list conversations, 'turns' to get messages for specific chats, 'begin' to start a turn, 'complete' to finish one, or 'clear' to delete history before a timestamp.

chatKeys.description: Up to 40 conversation keys (for turns action)

functions.name: admin_gmail_account
functions.title: Read Gmail Account
functions.description: Read a connected Gmail inbox's profile or recent messages. Admin only. Use action 'profile' for account info or 'recent' for the latest 5 inbox messages.

connectorId.description: The Gmail connector ID to read from

action.description: profile = account info, recent = latest 5 inbox messages

functions.name: admin_personal_calendar
functions.title: Manage Personal Calendar
functions.description: List upcoming Google Calendar events or create a new event. Admin only. Use action 'list' for upcoming events or 'create' with title, start, and end ISO datetimes.

action.description: list = upcoming events, create = new event

end.description: End ISO datetime (for create, must be after start)

functions.name: agency_drive_ingest
functions.title: Google Drive Operations
functions.description: Manage files and folders in the agency's Google Drive. Admin only. Actions: recentFiles (list recent files), folders (list folders), ensureFolder (create/find a folder), upload (upload a private file to a folder), projectFolder (get or create a project's folder chain), saveProjectText (save a markdown document to a project folder). All write actions require approved=true.

fileUri.description: Private file URI to upload (for upload)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file (for upload)

approved.description: Must be true for write actions

functions.name: benchmark_hub
functions.title: Benchmark Audit Hub
functions.description: Access the benchmark audit hub: list criteria, catalog, roadmap, checkpoints, enhancement jobs, and save reports to Drive. Admin only. Actions: info, catalog, checkpoint, saveCheckpoint, roadmap, prepare, plan, jobs, saveDrive.

functions.name: benchmark_validator
functions.title: Benchmark Validator
functions.description: Run benchmark validation: execute a read-only validation run, self-check, or review a plan. Admin only. Actions: run (execute validation), selfcheck (run self-checks), reviewPlan (review an enhancement plan).

functions.name: benchmark_coding
functions.title: Benchmark Coding Automation
functions.description: Manage the benchmark coding automation system on GitHub. Admin only. Actions: status (check automation health), install (install automation), enable, pause, run, authorizeLive (authorize live release). All actions except status require approved=true.

approved.description: Must be true for all actions except status

functions.name: bootstrap_supabase
functions.title: Bootstrap Supabase Auth
functions.description: Configure Supabase Google OAuth credentials, redirect URLs, and the profiles table with auto-create trigger. Admin only. Use dryRun=true to validate without writing.

supabaseAccessToken.description: Optional Supabase PAT; otherwise uses the connected Supabase connector

functions.name: commerce_checkout
functions.title: Create Stripe Checkout Session
functions.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a catalog item. Returns a URL the buyer navigates to. No auth required — public endpoint. Pass the catalog item ID, buyer name, email, and a valid HTTPS return URL.

clientId.description: Optional client UUID if logged in

functions.name: commerce_approve
functions.title: Approve Paid Order
functions.description: Approve a paid commerce order and create or link a client project. Admin only. The order must be in 'paid_awaiting_approval' status and the client email must match a registered user.

clientId.description: Registered client user ID matching the order email

functions.name: comms_console
functions.title: Communications Console
functions.description: Manage SMS/text conversations, send outbound messages, create agent personas, and manage campaigns. Admin only. Actions: list (conversations), messages (get messages for a conversation), send (send SMS), updateConversation, listAgents, createAgent, listPlaybooks, listCampaigns, createCampaign, status.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (for send)

functions.name: crm_assist
functions.title: Draft CRM Follow-Up Email
functions.description: Generate a polite follow-up email draft for a CRM contact using the AI Gateway. Admin only. Pass the CRM contact ID; returns a subject and body.

contactId.description: CRM contact ID to draft a follow-up for

functions.name: crm_follow_ups
functions.title: Send Scheduled CRM Follow-Ups
functions.description: Process all due scheduled CRM follow-up emails and send them via Gmail. Admin only. Returns the count of sent and failed follow-ups.

functions.name: crm_google
functions.title: Google CRM Operations
functions.description: Sync CRM contacts with Google Contacts and Calendar. Admin only. Actions: listContacts (list Google Contacts), saveContact (sync a CRM contact to Google Contacts), listCalendar (list upcoming events), createCall (schedule a 30-min strategy call with a contact).

start.description: Future ISO datetime for the call (for createCall)

functions.name: dashboard_metrics
functions.title: Dashboard Metrics
functions.description: Get aggregated agency dashboard metrics: leads by type and trend, CRM contacts by status, content counts, commerce orders by status, and domain traffic data. Admin only.

functions.name: dispatch_agent_task
functions.title: Dispatch Agent Task
functions.description: Create, list, bulk-create, cancel, or get a queue summary of agent tasks. Admin only. Actions: create (single task), bulk_create (multiple tasks), list (filter tasks), queue_summary (per-agent counts), cancel (delete a task).

task_type.description: Task category, e.g. google_connect, build_system (for create)

autonomous.description: Whether the task is autonomous (for create)

limit.description: Max tasks to return (for list, default 50)

functions.name: domain_operations
functions.title: Domain Operations
functions.description: Analyze a domain's SEO health: fetch sitemap, read Google Search Console and Analytics data, scan competitors, and generate strategic insights. Admin only. Pass a domain_id or domain name.

functions.name: dominance_engine
functions.title: Digital Dominance Engine
functions.description: Launch and manage fully automated digital dominance campaigns. Admin only. Actions: launch (start a new campaign with keyword, city, state), runPhase (run a specific phase), runAll (run all remaining phases), getStatus (poll progress), listActive (list campaigns), fameScore (calculate fame score).

functions.name: execute_autonomous_action
functions.title: Execute Autonomous Action
functions.description: Execute real autonomous actions: send SMS/MMS, make voice calls, run AI tasks, scrape web pages, create CRM leads, and send playbook messages. Admin only. Actions: capability_status, send_sms, send_mms, make_call, ai_task, web_scrape, create_lead, send_playbook_message.

to_number.description: Recipient phone in E.164 format (for send_sms/send_mms/make_call)

day.description: Day number in the sequence (for send_playbook_message)

contact.description: Contact object with phone and name (for send_playbook_message)

functions.name: execute_generator
functions.title: Execute Generator DAG
functions.description: Execute a DAG-based generator by key, or deploy a completed run to sandbox or production. Admin only. Pass generator_id and input; optionally set action to deploy_sandbox or deploy_production with a run_id.

action.description: execute = run the DAG, deploy_sandbox/deploy_production = deploy a completed run

functions.name: factory_os
functions.title: Factory OS
functions.description: Manage the generator factory: CRUD generators, runs, steps, artifacts, validation receipts, repair tasks, approvals, projects, template packs, adapters, and provisioning plans. Admin only. Pass an action and the relevant fields for that action.

functions.name: frontend_factory
functions.title: Frontend Factory
functions.description: Persist compiled BuildSpecs, list/get/delete specs, and dispatch build tasks to sandbox workers. Admin only for persist/dispatchBuild/deleteSpec. Actions: persist, listSpecs, getSpec, dispatchBuild, deleteSpec.

functions.name: generate_logo
functions.title: Generate Logo
functions.description: Generate a professional brand logo using the AI Gateway image endpoint. Authenticated users. Pass a brand name and optional colors and style.

style.description: Logo style description (default: Modern minimalist geometric mark)

functions.name: generate_sitemap
functions.title: Generate and Submit Sitemap
functions.description: Generate an XML sitemap for all static pages, blog posts, and projects, upload it to public storage, and submit it to Google Search Console. Admin only.

functions.name: generate_viral_presets
functions.title: Generate Viral Color Presets
functions.description: Generate trending color palette presets for SaaS/tech brands using the AI Gateway. Authenticated users. Pass an optional count (1-12, default 6).

count.description: Number of presets to generate (1-12, default 6)

functions.name: ingest_template
functions.title: Ingest and Manage Templates
functions.description: Ingest raw HTML templates, update extracted patterns, list/get/delete/activate/deactivate templates. Admin only. Actions: ingest, update, list, get, delete, activate, deactivate.

content.description: Raw HTML content (for ingest, max 50000 chars)

functions.name: list_portal_clients
functions.title: List Portal Clients
functions.description: List all registered client (role=user) profiles from the agency's Supabase project. Admin only. Returns id, email, full_name, and role for each client.

functions.name: manage_sandboxes
functions.title: Manage Sandboxes
functions.description: Create, list, delete, and health-check Railway and local sandbox environments. Admin only. Actions: list, create_railway, create_local, delete, health_check, railway_environments.

agent_name.description: Agent name to assign (for create actions)

functions.name: process_auto_build_step
functions.title: Process Auto Builder Step
functions.description: Execute a single pipeline step for an AutoBuild record (marketing or system-build pipeline). Admin or employee. Pass build_id, step name, and optionally advance (default true) and force (to override a running lock).

advance.description: Auto-advance to the next step after completion (default true)

functions.name: provision_client_infrastructure
functions.title: Provision Client Infrastructure
functions.description: Provision GitHub repos, Vercel projects, Railway services, and Supabase databases for client projects. Admin only (list action available to authenticated users). Actions: listMine, list, create, github, vercel, railway, railwayService.

functions.name: provision_customer_database
functions.title: Provision Customer Supabase Database
functions.description: List Supabase organizations and sites, or create a new Supabase project for a client. Admin only. Actions: list (organizations + sites), create (new Supabase project).

infrastructureId.description: Optional infrastructure record to link (for create)

functions.name: provision_site
functions.title: Provision Website Deployment
functions.description: Full website provisioning pipeline: GitHub repo + Vercel project + optional Supabase. Admin only. Actions: provision (full pipeline), github_only, supabase_only, list, get, delete, refresh_deployment.

functions.name: provision_system
functions.title: Provision Full System Stack
functions.description: Unified infrastructure orchestrator: provision an entire system stack (GitHub + Vercel + Railway + Supabase + GoDaddy domain) in one call, or manage individual resources. Admin only. Actions: provision, github, vercel, railway, supabase, domain_check, domain_configure, envVars, list, get, dashboard, update, delete.

functions.name: recover_stuck_auto_builds
functions.title: Recover Stuck Auto Builds
functions.description: Scan for AutoBuild records stuck in 'running' status or in 'failed' status, and recover them by re-running their current step. Admin only. Returns counts of scanned, recovered, skipped, and marked_failed builds.

functions.name: run_agent_chat
functions.title: Run Agent Chat
functions.description: Run a conversation with a specialist agent (orchestrator, growth_operator, code_architect, social_strategist, sales_engine, brand_guardian, replicator, swarm) with native tool calling for live system operations. Admin only. Pass agent_name and a messages array.

agent_name.description: Which specialist agent to chat with

functions.name: run_agent_loop
functions.title: Run Agent Loop
functions.description: Execute a bounded loop of pending autonomous agent tasks (up to 20 cycles). Admin only. Processes tasks by type: google_connect, index_check, competitor_scan, social_connect, build_system, growth_audit, content_optimize. Returns cycles run, actions executed, and follow-ups dispatched.

functions.name: run_autonomous_build
functions.title: Run Autonomous Build Cycle
functions.description: Drive the AutoBuilder pipeline: find builds with auto_advance=true and process their next step (max 3 per cycle). Admin only. Enforces blast-radius caps and governance tier checks.

functions.name: run_batch_operation
functions.title: Run Batch Operation
functions.description: Create an Apex-governed Swarm Nexus website-factory batch. Persists one BatchOperation, materializes site compile tasks in bounded waves, checkpoints progress, and dispatches through AgentTask. Shadow mode is the safe default. Admin only.

batch_size.description: Total websites in this factory mission.

swarm_enabled.description: Enable Swarm Nexus wave execution. Defaults true.

execution_mode.description: shadow = compile/validate only; execute = allow approved downstream promotion.

swarm_concurrency.description: Requested worker concurrency for the mission.

wave_size.description: Sites materialized into the AgentTask queue per wave.

functions.name: run_business_audit
functions.title: Run Business Diagnostic Audit
functions.description: Deterministic business diagnostic engine — real HTTP checks with no LLM. Admin only. Actions: runAudit (full scan of a company URL), generateRepairPlan (30-60-90 day plan), dashboardStats, listAudits, getAudit, approveFinding, generateOutreach, runMonitoring, getSystemMap, getRevenueLeaks, getEvidence, getSnapshots, getReceipts, getTechStack.

functions.name: run_growth_mission
functions.title: Run Growth Mission
functions.description: Run a growth mission for a domain: fetch robots.txt, discover and inspect sitemap, compute health score, generate LLM insight, update the domain record, and dispatch follow-up tasks. Admin only. Pass a domain name.

domain.description: Domain name to run the growth mission for

functions.name: run_meta_architect
functions.title: Run Meta Architect
functions.description: Run the Meta Architect mission: inspect the system registry, dispatch a task, run a growth mission on the first domain, and generate a strategic mission brief via the AI Gateway. Admin only. Pass an optional goal.

goal.description: Strategic goal for the mission (default: audit the system and dispatch follow-up tasks)

functions.name: run_site_clone
functions.title: Clone Website
functions.description: Deterministic site-clone engine: fetch a target site, inline CSS, rehost images, rewrite links, swap branding, and compute a parity score. Admin only. Actions: cloneSite, listQueue, dashboardStats, deleteItem, updateStatus.

functions.name: sandbox_auth
functions.title: Sandbox Worker Auth
functions.description: Sandbox worker authentication and task polling/execution/reporting endpoint. Authenticated via sandbox API key (sk_sbx_...), not user session. Actions: poll (claim tasks), execute (run a task), report (submit result), heartbeat, health (admin-only).

agent_name.description: Agent name to poll for (for poll)

functions.name: send_form_emails
functions.title: Send Form Notification Emails
functions.description: Send agency notification emails for form submissions (contact, quotation, newsletter, search, pricing). Admin only. Requires approved=true. Notifies the site owner only.

functions.name: sync_lead_to_crm
functions.title: Sync Lead to CRM
functions.description: Sync a Lead record to the CRM contacts table, creating a CrmContact with a scheduled follow-up. No auth required — uses service role. Pass lead_id.

functions.name: vault_backup
functions.title: Encrypted Vault Backup
functions.description: Create, list, or preview encrypted vault backups stored in Google Drive. Admin only. Actions: create (new encrypted backup), list (list existing backups), preview (decrypt and preview a backup).

functions.name: vault_connection
functions.title: Verify Vault Connection
functions.description: Verify a connected OAuth account (GitHub, Supabase, or Google Drive) for the vault. Admin only. Pass the connector ID.

connectorId.description: Connector ID to verify (GitHub, Supabase, or Drive slot)

functions.name: vault_key_admin
functions.title: Manage Vault Access Keys
functions.description: List, create, or revoke directory-read vault access keys. Admin only. Actions: list (your keys), create (new key with label and 7/30/90 day expiry), revoke (revoke a key by ID).

functions.name: advance_batch_wave
functions.title: Advance Website Factory Wave
functions.description: Advance an existing Swarm Nexus website-factory BatchOperation by materializing the next bounded site wave only when the current wave has no pending or in-progress tasks. Admin only.
